goal: Use the complete supplier geography corpus in VII vacation and event discovery, including zero-inventory destinations with truthful nearby recovery and editorially controlled SEO pages.

intent_model.literal_request: Import every city, area and main area from Sergey and Maxim, cross-reference it with the API, show all destinations in search, show nearby places where inventory is empty and make destination pages possible.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Geography is an independent platform capability rather than a side effect of current business inventory.
likely_rejections: Only the unassigned sample is imported
A destination can be selected but still produces a dead end

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: The supplier hierarchy is complete and independent of current listings.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Validate hierarchy counts and named zero-inventory cities from the exact response.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Only geographically defensible nearby inventory is shown and labeled as nearby.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Use city coordinates and bounded distance ordering; never silently fall back to arbitrary nationwide results.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Choose a destination in vacation or events.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Select an exact city or area even when it currently has no listed business.
cognitive_flow.next_action: See exact matches or a clearly labeled nearby recovery set and optionally progress the destination through the editorial page workflow.
deferred_complexity: Editorial content and indexation remain an admin approval decision

natural_destination: Production vacation and event destination pickers, their zero-inventory result pages, /admin/geography and the approved search-page sitemap pipeline

facts.claim: The supplier documents that numeric IDs are unique only within their geography level.
facts.evidence: Maxim message supplied by Adir on 2026-10-15

facts.claim: The current production public geography endpoint exposes only the unassigned Bayt Lid sample.
facts.evidence: GET https://vii.spaplus.co/api/vii/geography returned one node during preflight

facts.claim: VII already has a protected geography admin source and a public managed geography endpoint.

assumptions.claim: The complete supplier response may use object-keyed hierarchy roots not covered by the current named collection parser.
assumptions.validation: The current parser imports only root.unassigned while the supplier states that the endpoint contains the complete hierarchy; inspect the exact response shape through a bounded admin diagnostic if robust inference is insufficient.

in_scope: Editorial SEO eligibility and sitemap gating
out_of_scope: Automatic indexation of every imported location
invariants: Supplier listing inventory remains authoritative for whether a place exists in a city
Geography identity includes level and supplier ID
Nearby results are labeled and never represented as local
Only approved canonical useful pages enter sitemaps

requirements.statement: Import all supported hierarchy variants from the supplier areas endpoint.
Expose every visible managed geography in vacation and event destination search.
Recover zero-inventory destination searches with bounded nearby inventory.
Preserve editorial control of indexation and sitemap membership.
requirements.source: User request, VII platform master plan and SEO standard

requirements.statement: Allow administrators to inspect and override the imported corpus without losing supplier truth.

acceptance_checks.setup: Supplier response contains named or object-keyed districts, areas, cities, overlapping numeric IDs and unassigned nodes.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every valid node is stored under a level-scoped key, counts cover all levels, Yashresh is present, Bayt Lid remains unassigned and manual overrides survive.

acceptance_checks.setup: Yashresh exists in managed geography and has no vacation or event listing.
acceptance_checks.action: Type Yashresh in each destination picker and submit.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Yashresh is selectable in both worlds and the selected destination persists in the URL and heading.

acceptance_checks.setup: The selected city has coordinates but no exact listings and nearby inventory has coordinates.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A clearly labeled nearby result set is sorted by distance within the bounded recovery radius and each card retains its true city.

acceptance_checks.setup: The selected geography has no usable coordinates or no inventory exists inside the maximum radius.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The UI shows an honest empty state and recovery controls, without arbitrary nationwide listings.

acceptance_checks.setup: A geography is imported but has no approved editorial page.
acceptance_checks.action: Refresh the corpus and sitemap inventory.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The geography stays searchable but no URL enters the sitemap until the existing approval workflow publishes a canonical useful page.

acceptance_checks.setup: The supplier request fails or returns a structurally invalid payload.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The accepted geography corpus is preserved and the admin receives a clear failure; partial data is not accepted as a successful full refresh.

authorization_boundary: Read-only supplier pulls, implementation, verification and the standing VII publication workflow are authorized. Automatic publication or indexation of thin geography pages is prohibited.
